blocks.text: Watch a video about Internet & SaaS Posture Profiles.

The posture profile is a set of criteria evaluated on a user’s device that you can use in an Internet & SaaS (ZIA) policy. You can create an Internet & SaaS posture profile for a specific trust level and add it to an app profile. To learn more about posture profiles, see About Internet & SaaS Posture Profiles.

blocks.heading: Creating an Internet & SaaS Posture Profile

blocks.text: To add an Internet & SaaS posture profile for Zscaler Client Connector:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Internet & SaaS Posture Profiles.
Click Add ZIA Posture. The Add ZIA Posture window appears.
In the Add ZIA Posture window:
For Posture Definition, enter a Posture Name.

For High Trust, Medium Trust, Low Trust: Choose a trust level. Posture checks for all trust levels are evaluated by Zscaler Client Connector on the device and the highest matching level is used in the Internet & SaaS posture.
To define the expression:
Click the Select Device Posture drop-down menu to view a list of available postures.
Select a device posture for the trust level. You can search for a specific device posture and click Clear All to remove all items.
Click Add to include another device posture and repeat the first two steps. You can select up to 5 device postures.
Review your expression in the Expression Preview field. Within a group, the logic is AND. Between groups, the logic is OR.
Click Save.

blocks.heading: Assign an Internet & SaaS Posture Profile to an App Profile

blocks.text: Posture profiles are evaluated on devices assigned to app profiles. To add an Internet & SaaS posture profile to an existing or new app profile:

blocks.item: Go to Infrastructure > Connectors > Client.
Under Platform Settings, select the OS platform you want to add the policy to.
On the App Profiles tab, select one of the following:
Select an existing policy and click Edit.
Click Add <OS> Policy to create a new policy.
In the ZIA Posture Profile drop-down menu, select the Internet & SaaS posture profile you created.
When finished, do one of the following:
Click Save if you're editing an existing policy.
Click Add if you're creating a new policy.
